# The cart, by the numbers

The same modelling applied to the matcha cart instead of the garage. Drinks and
prices are read from `menu.json`: the **17 drinks** across
Coffee, Matcha, Cold. The grill stays home.

## What a drink is worth

| Section | Drinks | Average price |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Coffee | 6 | $3.53 |
| Matcha | 7 | $5.17 |
| Cold | 4 | $4.45 |
| **All drinks** | **17** | **$4.42** |

Cost to make, blended at 55.0% matcha: **$1.44**
(matcha $0.64 at 4g of $160/kg, or coffee $0.80,
plus milk $0.38 and cup $0.35).
Gross margin per drink: **$2.98**
(67.4%).

## How few events it takes

Events carry the year. Holding markets and fixed costs where they are:

| Events a year | EBITDA |
| --- | ---: |
| 0 | -$131 |
| 10 | $4,194 |
| 20 | $8,520 |
| 30 | $12,845 |
| 40 | $17,170 |
| 50 | $21,496 |

Break-even is about **1 event a year** alongside the market days.
